title: Mathias Lauber
text:
Data Professional · Switzerland
      Mathias Lauber
      Data & Insights Analyst @ World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA)
      
        I'm a data professional based in Switzerland, specialising in transforming complex data into
        actionable insights, robust products, and compelling visual stories. At the Swiss Federal Statistical Office,
        I sat at the intersection of engineering, analysis, and design — building the infrastructure that powers
        federal statistics, and crafting the visualizations that communicate them to the public.
      
      
        My background gives me a strong quantitative foundation and a spatial perspective on data problems.
        Over the years, I've expanded into data engineering (Databricks, PySpark, ETL pipelines),
        BI products (semantic models, data catalogs, Streamlit apps), machine learning, and data community
        management — always with a focus on usability and impact.
      
      
        🔗 LinkedIn
        ✉ Email
        📊 Portfolio
      
    

  






  
  Experience

  
  
    Data & Insights Analyst
    World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA)
    📅 March 2025 – Present
    
      
        Interface between business users and data architects — identifying data needs and translating them into technical requirements
        Building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, PySpark and Databricks
        Creating scripts and automated jobs for data ingestion and refresh
        Developing BI products: reports, semantic data models, schemas and data catalogs
        Building interactive Streamlit applications for internal data access
        Animating and growing the internal data community
        Data analysis, machine learning and log / activity analysis
      
    
    
      PythonPySpark
      DatabricksSQL
      ETL / ELT
      StreamlitSemantic Models
      MLData Community
    
  

  
  
    Data Visualization Specialist
    Swiss Federal Statistical Office (FSO · OFS)
    📅 February 2023 – February 2025
    
      
        Designing and coding interactive, dynamic visualizations for federal statistics publications
        Optimizing visualization pipelines and processes (~9,000 assets/year)
        Scrollytelling, interactive charts, maps and small multiples
        Responsive design from mobile to wide screen
      
    
    
      D3.jsDatawrapper
      R / ggplot2Scrollytelling
      GISMaps
    
  

  

  
  Education

  
    Master of Science — Spatial Analysis & Complex Systems
    University of Lausanne (UNIL)
    📅 2019 – 2022 · Geosciences and Environment
    
      Quantitative methods · Data wrangling & visualization · Networks & spatial modelling ·
      Statistics · Sustainability assessments · Geodata & mapping
    
  

  
    Bachelor of Science — Geography
    University of Lausanne (UNIL)
    📅 2016 – 2019 · Geosciences and Environment

    ETL Pipelines
    Data Warehousing

    Databricks
  




  
    Building the data backbone of global anti-doping — from raw source systems to
    governed, queryable data and live dashboards that teams rely on every day.

      Sources

      Data Warehouse
      Delta Lake
    
    →
    
      🔍
      Querying
      SQL · Semantic Models
    
    →
    
      📊
      Dashboards
      Real-time · Self-serve
    
  

  
  What I Build

  

    
      ⚙️
      ETL / ELT Pipelines
      Robust, automated pipelines that ingest, clean and transform data from heterogeneous source systems into a single trusted layer — scheduled, monitored and idempotent.
      
        PySpark
        Apache Spark
        Workflows
        Python
      
    

    
      🏛️
      Data Warehousing
      Designing and maintaining a Lakehouse on Delta Lake — bronze/silver/gold layers, partitioning and schema management for reliable, performant storage.
      
        Delta Lake
        Lakehouse
        Schema Design
        Medallion
      
    

    
      🔍
      Querying & Modelling
      Performant SQL and semantic models that turn warehouse tables into business-ready datasets — well-documented, governed and easy to consume.
      
        SQL
        Semantic Models
        Optimization
        Data Catalog
      
    

    
      🤝
      Data Provisioning
      Making clean data available to users — analysts, federations and partners — through governed access, curated datasets and self-serve interfaces.
      
        Self-Serve
        Governance
        Access Control
        Data Sharing
      
    

    
      📊
      Real-time Dashboards
      Dashboards plugged directly into the data warehouse, refreshing in real time so decision-makers always work with the latest figures — no manual exports.
      
        Real-time
        BI Reports
        Live Refresh
        KPIs
      
    

    
      🧱
      Databricks Platform
      The backbone of it all: Databricks as a unified platform for engineering, warehousing and analytics — from notebooks and jobs to Unity Catalog governance.
      
        Databricks
        Unity Catalog
        Jobs
        Delta Lake
